reviews.text:
I have been taking my dog Mousse here for the last 2+ years and have always been happy for the service and care that they provide.

Their team, from the staff at the front desks to the vets themselves have all been phenomenal. They are eager to help when necessary and show passion when sharing their expertise.

Recently, we visited them for the final Fit-to-Fly vet appointment as we are leaving the country and throughout the whole process. Dr. Erin Reid and the LV team have been very detail oriented and precise with the paperwork required for us to move my dog overseas.

For anyone living in Liberty Village and surrounding area, this is the vet clinic to trust your pets care with.

The staff were incredibly kind, compassionate, and gentle during one of the most difficult moments we’ve ever faced. Saying goodbye to our beloved dog was heartbreaking, but the veterinarian took the time to explain everything, answer our questions, and give us the privacy and support we needed. They treated our dog with dignity and tenderness throughout the entire process. We are deeply grateful for their kindness and would recommend them to anyone facing this difficult decision.

My dog had some delayed side effects after a dental cleaning and extractions and the team has been very supportive throughout. I specifically wanted to shoutout Joan for all her support during this past weekend (even though they were closed) and helping me navigate this. As a pet parent is always stressful and painful when something is going on and you don’t know exactly what to do - Joan was very attentive and helped me navigate the situation until the next business day that I could take my dog in for a check up. Thank you!

I would give zero stars if I could. My cat Pinky passed away while under their care, and this clinic was dismissive every step of the way. I called multiple times reporting emergency symptoms a day after she was in this vet and was told to just wait until after the long weekend for blood results. When I finally went in person to get answers for blood test after 6 days. Courtney the manager was cold, dismissive, and offered a robotic 'condolences' with zero empathy . My baby died, and they couldn't even show basic compassion. If you love your pet, please find a vet that actually cares. I would not recommend this place to anyone.
I have been coming to this establishment ever since my boy was a puppy.  He is 11 now and I wouldnt go anywhere else.  The service is absolutely incredible. Keep up the amazing work.

Dr Kinsel and her team have provided excellent care to my dog over the 5 years we’ve been coming to the clinic. The team is very thorough and takes the time to explain everything with such compassion for my dog, and me as the person taking care of her.

Even if I moved out of the neighbourhood I would continue to bring my dog to Liberty Village Animal Hospital.

Absolutely love this animal hospital. The staff and doctors really seem to care about their clients. I have a nervous Bernese and we were due for vaccines. The first time we attempted, Berner would not let it happen. Dr. Reid (she’s amazing 🩷) knew not to push him, so we rebooked free of charge and tried again with the help of medication. Berner was still nervous but we completed the shots and hopefully got a little more comfortable for next time 🙏 Highly recommend!

I’ve been taking my dog here for about 6 months, and I absolutely love this team. They genuinely treat your pets like their own and truly understand how stressful it is when your little one isn’t well.

What really stands out is their follow-up and care.They make an effort to accommodate you when your pet is unwell rather than simply saying there are no appointments. I’ve never felt pressured into unnecessary tests or medications either.

I feel incredibly grateful to have found such caring, honest, and trustworthy vets. ❤️

Dr Kinzle was my cat's veterinarian for over a decade and always provided the best care for him. Her genuine compassion and dedication to the animals she cares for truly shines through. I will always be grateful for everything she did for Midnite and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a caring and wonderful veterinarian.

Dr. Kinzl is the only veterinarian I would ever unequivocally trust with my pet. She took care of my late Frenchie & us for many years, showing that empathy isn’t lost on us human beings, that being down to earth, honest, and practising with love earns you unconditional respect. We love you Kinzl and Scottie is eternally grateful to you. Please don’t hesitate to entrust your pet to Dr. Kinzl, she’s truly one of a kind.

My little Bishop recently passed on at the emergency hospital and Liberty Village Animal hospital was his home vet, so his ashes were sent here. I was so touched about a month later to receive a letter from the U of Guelph, letting me know LV Animal hospital made a donation to their pet trust in Bishop’s name. This was such a sweet surprise, especially during a time where I’m searching for any sign from my Bishop. Thank you LV Animal Hospital!
Great DVMs, great support and front desk staff.
Thank you Alejandro!
Caring calm and supportive. Please make this vet your vet. Private is so much better than going to a private equity vet clinic.

No idea how this clinic has a rating of 4.6 - they must be padding this reviews with friends and family. I was previously a client at this clinic, but the moment I asked to have my dog's medical history sent to another vet, they removed my file with them (probably so they can respond that they are confused about my review as I am not a client with them).

The last issue I came to their clinic was when my senior dog had an eye ulcer. The vets here dragged his recovery for over 3 weeks just to milk more money out of me. He was clearly in pain and they wanted to continue the same ineffective treatment for another week. After I insisted on getting a referral to a specialist - they then dragged their feet on spending the 10min to make the referral and send along my dogs medical history.  This clinic only cares about drawing as much money out of their clients as possible and not about providing care and comfort to our furry family members.

Their receptionist is exceptionally rude, as mentioned in many other reviews here. Yet they always seem confused and unaware of any rude employees.

Update: Google reviews is not the forum to discuss private matters and resolve issues. I've given up on that as your clinic staff have refused to take any accountability for your discussions and actions. This is the forum to advise others on my personal experience with your clinic, so that they can make the best decisions for their pets. You are not at liberty to publicly discuss private communications with former clients. But thank you for demonstrating just how petty and spiteful your staff chose to be.
The best clinic in toronto ! Brought my dog in and Claudia made it the best and most seamless process ever !
The best vet hospital in Toronto! The receptionist Claudia was so attentive and had a magnetic aura !

I chose to continue my senior Labrador’s care elsewhere after concerns regarding repeat anal gland visits.
Following the initial anal gland expression, my dog remained very uncomfortable and continued displaying the same symptoms that had prompted the visit. This led me to return for a revisit.

During the revisit and subsequent phone conversations, my questions regarding the ongoing anal gland concerns and the reason my dog remained uncomfortable after the initial visit were not addressed.
Discussions instead were diverted and focused primarily on calorie intake, and the connection between diet and the reason for the revisit was not explained.

The explanations later provided by management differed from those given during the appointment.

Worried pet owners, especially during revisits, would benefit from clearer communication, patience, and compassion. The clinic did provide his medical records promptly upon request, which I appreciated.

I chose to seek care elsewhere.

I came in because my dog was having a choking scare, and I was absolutely beside myself. I was in tears and incredibly upset, but the receptionist was so kind, calm, and reassuring throughout the entire interaction. What I appreciated most was her honesty and professionalism. Since my dog had already vomited the object he was choking on, she advised me to monitor him closely at home and gave me helpful guidance. I was grateful that she didn't immediately push for a vet visit when she genuinely didn't think it was necessary. This experience has really stayed with me. In a stressful moment, I felt supported, informed, and cared for. I can't recommend them highly enough.

Oh My God! You touched our hearts again & again 💞 I can’t say you enough “Thank you “ for all the cares that showed for our beauty Boxer girl Mocha 💓

From being in your care for Mocha’s Auto immune disease  for years till her Cancer after that  to the end & the Final day & after that  receiving flowers & sympathy cards & even till today ……..,
Every moment that We remember our Mocha from that day till now, your clinic’s excellent  care is next to that ! & we are so grateful to have you with us in the hard journey 😢
it is very important to have a caring team  like yours to by our sides to go through to such difficult  moments !
We never gorget you 🫶🏻
thousands times thanks to have you & your team by our sides to pass through to such difficult moments , Thank you again

I took my dog here for the first time a couple of weeks ago and had a very good experience. The staff were friendly, organized, and made the whole process easy from start to finish. I especially appreciated how simple they make it to stay on top of appointments and follow-ups through their email reminder system.

I was referred by a friend, and I am really glad to now have access to such great veterinary care in a convenient location. They also did not charge for the follow-up appointment, which was a very pleasant surprise.

One thing that really stood out to me was how easy they made it to transfer records from my previous vet and coordinate ongoing care. They helped set everything up so my other vet still receives updates, which means records stay fully up to date across clinics if care is needed elsewhere while out of town.

That level of cooperation and continuity of care is incredibly valuable for people who have cottages, travel frequently, or split their time between two places and may occasionally need to see a different local vet. It gave me a lot of confidence knowing they genuinely prioritize what is best for the pet, rather than making owners feel pressured to use only one clinic.

Overall, a very positive experience and I would definitely recommend them.

First time visit with Dr. Yufuko.

May, 2026 : Back a year later and met Dr. Jeff who was very good with Burgess who didn't even flinch after getting 3 needles. Thank you.
Great vet with kind and informative staff, fair pricing and a convenient location.
Thank you Elizabeth!
Thank you Ingrid!
Vincent’s favourite place in Toronto!!!! Not enough good things to say about this place. They are the best!!!!

We used Liberty Village Animal Hospital for our little dog for about 4 years. They were always so kind, attentive and proactive about his care with sending reminders for his shots etc.
We left Canada and the clinic were so supportive with information and plans before his flight. Forever grateful that we had their expertise in this area.

What an incredible experience at Liberty village animal hospital!The whole team is beyond friendly—warm smiles, gentle hands, and they even had treats ready for our nervous furball. The doctor’s professionalism totally blew us away; they took time to explain every detail, answered all our questions with such patience and expertise. And get this—our tiny kitten didn’t feel a single thing during the vaccine! 😻
We can’t recommend the Liberty village animal hospital —absolutely everyone with a pet needs to experience this level of care!!!
Very good clinic. I came here before I move back to France with my cat and the people are very nice and helpful !

My husband and I, but more importantly our Tripawd Penny, love the staff at Liberty Village Animal Hospital- made evident by the fact that she will pull and cry outside of the building because she simply wants to stop in and say Hi.

There were many times where they were able to accommodate us at the last minute and we are thankful for their care, concern and communication.The staff was always friendly and professional while making sure Penny was comfortable and happy. We unfortunately have moved out of the area and will be switching vets, but if we are ever in the area we will make sure to stop by and have Penny say Hi to her favourite people.

Thank you for having us for 4 years!
